task_definition.task_name: Phase Picking using PhaseNet on Continuous Waveform

task_description.overview: Automatically detect P-wave and S-wave arrival times from continuous three-component seismic waveform data using a pretrained PhaseNet deep neural network model.
steps: Load the pretrained PhaseNet model and its configuration parameters.
Read the continuous waveform file (miniSEED format) using ObsPy.
Normalize the three-component waveform data (N, E, Z) by mean and max amplitude.
Run the PhaseNet inference method with specified overlap and probability thresholds for P and S phases.
Extract P-phase and S-phase arrival times from the model output.
Optionally, plot the normalized waveforms and mark the detected P and S arrival times on each component.

task_definition.agent_prompt: P-wave and S-wave phase picking using Phasenet on the continuous three-component waveform data. Load and normalize the continuous three-component waveform file at {waveform_path}. The pretrained Phasenet model is located at {pretrained_model_path} and its related parameters are located at {pretrained_param_path}. Run inference with the specific overlap, P_threshold, and S_threshold, save the picked results into a JSON file {result_data.file_name} with content {result_data.file_content}. Finally, plot a figure to show the waveform with the detected P-wave and S-wave picks. Save the figure to {waveform_with_picks}.
